Proposed diagram changes
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
  |   |-- [1a] Correct PersistentLayer
  |   |   `-- Keep DiagramStore's catalog and DiagramPersistence ownership. Show workspace, ChangeSession, saved-context, chat, workflow-run, and push-integration stores under their actual services, not DiagramStore. SearchArtifact remains PROPOSED and unimplemented.
  |   `-- [1b] Extend PersistentLayer
  |       `-- Show checkpoint deltas, shared immutable items and text, and retention of delta bases, issued revisions, saved views, working copies, and presentation, alternative, review, and diagram-context references. Include saved contexts and pinned sources, diagram-context associations, chat state, workflow runs, and push connection and generation records. Whole-canvas publication captures and flushes its checkpoint before advancing the catalog head.
  |
  `-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
      |   `-- Replace implied full-checkpoint writes with changed-record deltas, shared content-addressed items and text, dependency-aware restore, and unchanged-write suppression. Preserve existing incremental autosave, debounce, and batching.
      `-- [1b] Extend Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Show bounded concurrent durable blob writes before atomic manifest publication, then restoration to the portable workspace model. Show explicit checkpoint capture and storage flush before whole-canvas catalog publication, separate from ordinary autosave.
